title: Age, refunds & privacy
intro: Manage your age declaration and rights requests. These controls do not verify identity or prevent direct blockchain calls.
ageNotice: The server calculates whether you meet the age threshold, then discards the birth date. The result is self-declared, not independently verified.
acknowledge: I confirm this date is accurate and understand how it is used.
disabled: Age and country controls are disabled in this environment.
notice: Do not send seed phrases, private keys or identity documents. A refund request does not issue a payment. Signatures supplied here are references, not proof of entitlement.
exportNotice: This export covers profile fields, declarations and rights requests, not all operational records. Request access below for a broader review.
eraseConfirm: I understand this removes profile fields and sessions, not chain records, financial records, all logs or backups. The remaining scope needs review.
error: Could not complete the request. Check the fields or try again.
ageRequired: Complete the age declaration in Age, refunds & privacy before starting a new activity.
ageDenied: The declaration does not meet the age requirement. Use a correction request if you made a mistake.
regionRestricted: This activity is not available in the detected region.
countryUnknown: The server cannot determine your country from a trusted source.
privacyRestricted: Processing is restricted. Your requests and existing exit paths remain available.
invalid: Check the date, acknowledgement and current policy, then retry.
conflict: The request changed. Refresh before replying.
limit: Request limit reached. Add information to an existing case.
closed: This request is closed. Submit a new request if needed.
reauth: Sign out and sign in again before exporting data.
unknownFeature: This action is not supported by the access policy.
restrictionNotice: Restriction and objection requests suspend new activities. Ask the operator to review any later request to resume.
resetAge: Reset age declaration (requires a new declaration)
resumeProcessing: Resume processing after reviewing the user’s request
